synopsis: This monumental manga became the driving force behind Shonen Jump, the tough kid boss of the neighborhood, Mankichi Togawa, uses his fighting skills and charm to find friends as he takes on the bad guys and the big shots who control Japan's financial world. This series, which was followed enthusiastically by the youth of the time, blazed the trail for a new class of readers. This work embodies the spirit of the magazine Shonen Jump. It had a major influence on the authors who followed. In 1969, it became the first Shonen Jump work to be turned into animation, and in 1971 it was turned into a live action film. titleNative: 炎炎ノ消防隊
synopsis: Terror has paralyzed the clockwork metropolis of Tokyo! Possessed by demons, people have begun to burst into flame, leading to the establishment of a special firefighting team: the Fire Force, ready to roll on a moment's notice to fight spontaneous combustion anywhere it might break out. The team is about to get a very unique addition: Shinra, a boy who possesses the unique power to run at the speed of a rocket, leaving behind the famous "devil's footprints" (and destroying his shoes in the process). Can the Fire Force discover the source of this strange phenomenon and put a stop to it? Or will the city burn to ashes first? (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Determined to claim the throne, Ayane leverages Yuma's weakness to make him “conquer” her rival princess candidates to clear the path to her victory. title: Dalao Ni Tou You Diao Le
titleRomaji: Dalao Ni Tou You Diao Le
titleNative: 大佬你头又掉了
synopsis: As we all know, you can level up by killing monsters, and I am... that monster. As the only zombie on earth that can turn around and not die, I concealed my identity and kept a low profile as a zombie in order to protect myself. However, I was worried about my sick ex-girlfriend, so I secretly protected her. I didn't expect that my ex-girlfriend had become a female warrior who killed zombies without blinking an eye, and I was discovered by her? I wanted to escape, she wanted to chase me, we struggled and fell in love, and in the end you told me that the whole world had to die? Okay, I won't pretend anymore, I am actually a vaccine. (Source: Bilibili, translated)
